note: BLM campground in Carrizo Plain National Monument at the old KCL Ranch, half a mile off Soda Lake Rd, with some of the monument's few shade trees. Eight gravel sites sit in the east part of the loop; the four in the west are walk-in tent sites. A water spigot by site 3 may not be working, so bring water; no garbage service. Remote: no fuel, food or water nearby and spotty cell service; the monument's dirt roads turn slick after rain. --Claude
